Yes — this is what "real search" means to me. I typed "reorganize" and it narrowed straight down to the one bookmark, even though that word only lives in my private note, not the title or anything visible. That's the whole point: I want it to dig through everything I've attached to a link — the title, the description, the web address, the site, the labels, and my notes — not just the headline. And it filtered as I typed, which is exactly the feel I want, no hunting for a "go" button.

One thing I'd just want to confirm is in there: it shouldn't care about capital letters. If I type "reorganize" or "Reorganize" or "REORGANIZE," I'd expect the same result either way — I don't want to think about how I capitalized something when I'm just trying to find it again. Assuming that's the case, this search is spot on.
